versions.content: The Client Identifier of the transaction handle used for an inter- ECU client server communication may be defined at the ClientIdDefinition be- longing to the Ecu Extract and referring the operation instance. If defined the RTE generator shall take the clientId from the ClientIdDefinition . If not defined the RTE generator shall set the clientId to 0.
